ai_deductions.tag_zh: The Market Brew 深度框架 · 期限溢价与全球定价锚
ai_deductions.tag_en: The Market Brew Framework · Term Premium & Global Pricing Anchor
ai_deductions.context_zh: 美债10年期收益率重回4.2%上方，并非单纯由通胀反弹驱动，而是【期限溢价（Term Premium）】走阔与财政发债供给洪峰共振的结果。市场正在重新定价更高中性利率（r*）。
ai_deductions.context_en: The rebound in US 10Y yields above 4.2% is driven not merely by inflation, but by expanding Term Premium and heavy Treasury issuance. Markets are repricing a higher neutral rate (r*).
ai_deductions.transmission_zh:
1. 折现率渠道：长端无风险利率高位黏性 → 杀估值压力集中于自由现金流远期兑现的高估值科技股（PEG > 2.5x）；
2. 跨国利差渠道：美加利差走阔（美政策利率显著高于加拿大央行）→ 压制加元汇率（CAD/USD 逼近 0.72），但直接增厚以美元计价结算的加拿大能源出口商（如 CNQ.TO）的本币利润率。
ai_deductions.transmission_en:
1. Discount Rate Channel: Sticky long-end yields compress multiples on long-duration tech (PEG > 2.5x);
2. Cross-Border Rate Differential: Widening US-CA spread pressures CAD/USD (~0.72), directly boosting CAD-denominated margins for Canadian energy exporters (e.g., CNQ.TO) selling in USD.
ai_deductions.second_order_zh: 二阶效应（Second-Order Effect）：企业再融资成本居高不下，高杠杆中小盘股利息覆盖率恶化；相反，账面拥有巨额净现金或锁定超长久期低息债务的现金牛公司（高FCF + 稳健派息率 <60%），其利息收入反而成为利润增量。
ai_deductions.second_order_en: Second-Order Effect: Refinancing walls hurt levered small-caps, whereas cash-rich compounders with locked-in long-term debt earn higher interest on cash reserves, widening their moat.
ai_deductions.outcome_zh: 实操策略：标普500（PE分位 >85%）保持底仓不追高；超配短久期美债（SGOV 锁住 >4.5% 无风险收益）+ 加拿大能源/管道高息股 + 美股低PEG高现金流防御白马（SCHD）。
ai_deductions.outcome_en: Actionable Strategy: Hold S&P 500 core without chasing; overweight short-duration T-Bills (SGOV) + Canadian energy/pipeline dividend compounders + US low-PEG defensive value (SCHD).
ai_deductions.raw_data_zh: 核验底层数据：US 10Y = 4.24% | WTI 原油 = $71.78 | 金油比 = 38.1x（高于30均值，指示机构正在用黄金对冲财政赤字与地缘尾部风险）。
ai_deductions.raw_data_en: Verified Metrics: US 10Y = 4.24% | WTI = $71.78 | Gold/Oil Ratio = 38.1x (>30 avg, signaling institutional hedging against fiscal deficit & tail risks).

ai_deductions.tag_zh: The Market Brew 深度框架 · 中港资产负债表修复与股息套利
ai_deductions.tag_en: The Market Brew Framework · CN/HK Balance Sheet & Dividend Arbitrage
ai_deductions.context_zh: 国内10年期国债收益率维持在 2.12% 极低水位，而沪深300与恒生指数的盈利收益率（E/P）分别高达 8.2% 与 10.4%。无风险利率下行引发国内险资与长线机构的『资产荒』。
ai_deductions.context_en: China's 10Y government bond yield sits near 2.12%, while CSI 300 and Hang Seng earnings yields (E/P) stand at 8.2% and 10.4%, creating an institutional 'asset famine' for yield.
ai_deductions.transmission_zh:
1. 股债利差传导：沪深300 ERP（股权风险溢价）达 6.1%，处于近5年 85% 分位以上；
2. 央行互换便利（SFISF）与回购增持再贷款落地 → 引导低成本信贷资金定向流入股息率 >5% 且派息率稳定的央国企龙头（借入 ~2.25% 资金买入 6% 股息资产，形成制度性套利底）。
ai_deductions.transmission_en:
1. ERP Channel: CSI 300 ERP at 6.1% (>85th 5Y percentile);
2. PBoC Swap & Buyback Facility: Enables institutions to borrow at ~2.25% to buy >5% yielding SOEs, establishing an institutional arbitrage floor.
ai_deductions.second_order_zh: 二阶效应（Second-Order Effect）：同一家央企在港股（H股）相比A股存在 30%~40% 折价，且港股红利对内地机构（通过港股通持有满12个月免征红利税）具备更高到手收益率，驱动南向资金持续加速抢筹港股高息电讯与资源垄断股。
ai_deductions.second_order_en: Second-Order Effect: Dual-listed H-shares trade at a 30-40% discount to A-shares, offering significantly higher effective dividend yields, driving persistent Southbound inflows into HK telecom and energy monopolies.
ai_deductions.outcome_zh: 实操策略：A股以红利低波（512890）与水电/能源垄断龙头为绝对核心；港股重点收集高股息率（>6.5%）、低派息率（<55%）且净现金充沛的央企（如中海油、中国移动）。
ai_deductions.outcome_en: Actionable Strategy: Anchor A-shares in Low-Vol Dividend ETF (512890) & hydro/energy monopolies; accumulate HK high-yield (>6.5%), low-payout (<55%) cash-rich SOEs (0883.HK, 0941.HK).
ai_deductions.raw_data_en: Verified Metrics: CN 10Y = 2.12% | CSI 300 PE = 12.2x | Implied ERP = (1/12.2) - 2.12% = 6.08% | Hang Seng AH Premium = 141.8.

liquidity_bar.formula_en: Formula: TSX Earnings Yield (1/16.2 = 6.17%) - CA 10Y Bond (3.42%) = +2.75%. BoC rate cuts boost dividend appeal.
Formula: CSI 300 Earnings Yield (1/12.2 = 8.20%) - CN 10Y (2.12%) = +6.08%. >5.5% signals historical bottom zone.

etfs.action_zh: 估值合理 / 底仓持有

etfs.name_zh: Vanguard 加拿大高股息 ETF
etfs.action_zh: 降息周期受益 / 定投吸筹 ⭐

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：北美最大油砂与重油生产商，油砂资产具备『零递减率』与40年超长寿命，无需像页岩油那样每年投入巨额资本开支维持产量，WTI盈亏平衡点低于35美元/桶。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: Largest oil sands producer in North America. Long-life, low-decline reserves require minimal maintenance CapEx vs US shale; WTI breakeven <$35/bbl.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：连续24年上调股息（5年分红复合增速高达18.5%），派息率仅54%。由于净债务已降至目标线以下，公司承诺将100%自由现金流通过分红与回购返还股东。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: 24 consecutive years of dividend increases (18.5% 5Y CAGR), conservative 54% payout ratio. 100% of free cash flow returned to shareholders.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：受短期油价回落至70美元拖累，股价自高点回撤近15%，PE处于5年28%低分位，按当前70美元油价测算自由现金流收益率（FCF Yield）超9%。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: Pulled back ~15% on short-term oil softness; trades at 28th 5Y PE percentile with >9% FCF yield even at $70 WTI.

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：加拿大五大寡头银行之一，拥有加拿大本土最强的低成本零售存款基础，受严格监管壁垒保护。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: Top-5 Canadian oligopoly bank with the strongest low-cost retail deposit franchise in Canada.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：经历美国反洗钱罚款一次性计提后，核心一级资本充足率（CET1）依然充裕，派息率维持在52%安全区间，连续百年派息未中断。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: Post-AML settlement clarity; strong CET1 capital ratio, safe 52% payout ratio, uninterrupted dividend record for over a century.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：利空落地后极度悲观情绪已完全计价（靴子落地），PE处于5年15%极低分位，超5.2%股息率处于历史高位，典型错杀反转标的。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: Regulatory overhang fully priced in; trading at 15th 5Y PE percentile with a historically high 5.24% dividend floor.

etfs.action_zh: 历史高位 / 仅底仓持有

etfs.name_zh: 嘉信美国高股息质量 ETF
etfs.action_zh: 高ROE筛选 / 价值定投首选 ⭐

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：全球肿瘤免疫之王（Keytruda）与HPV疫苗（Gardasil）双核驱动，新药Winrevair（肺动脉高压）开启百亿级新增长曲线。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: Global oncology leader (Keytruda) + Gardasil vaccine moat, with newly approved Winrevair opening a multi-billion growth leg.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：ROE超35%，自由现金流充沛，派息率仅42%，连续13年稳步提高分红。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: ROE >35%, massive FCF generation, conservative 42% payout ratio with 13 years of consecutive dividend hikes.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：因中国区疫苗阶段性去库存引发市场过度抛售，股价自高点回调超20%，PEG仅0.85（<1极度低估），远期PE仅11.5倍。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: Oversold by >20% on temporary China Gardasil destocking; trades at a 0.85 PEG ratio and ~11.5x forward earnings.

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：美国三大无线通信寡头之首，5G频谱与光纤网络资本开支高峰期已过，刚需订阅模式不受经济周期波动影响。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: US telecom oligopoly leader; 5G C-band CapEx peak is behind it, recurring subscription cash flows immune to macro cycles.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：年度自由现金流接近190亿美元，派息率59%，完全覆盖高额分红并持续偿还债务，连续18年增加股息。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: ~$19B annual FCF easily covers dividends (59% payout ratio) while de-leveraging; 18 consecutive years of dividend growth.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：PE仅9.3倍（处于5年18%低分位），6.45%股息率远超美债收益率，在降息周期中具备极强的类债重估弹性。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: 9.3x PE (18th 5Y percentile) and 6.45% yield offer a massive spread over Treasuries with upside re-rating potential as rates fall.

etfs.action_zh: 高股债性价比 / 分批配置

etfs.name_zh: 华泰柏瑞红利低波 ETF
etfs.action_zh: 险资底仓 / 强力定投 ⭐

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：坐拥乌东德、白鹤滩、溪洛渡、向家坝、三峡、葛洲坝六座巨型梯级水电站，独家垄断且不可复制，发电边际成本极低。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: Irreplaceable monopoly operating 6 mega cascade hydro stations on the Yangtze River with near-zero marginal generation cost.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：每年经营性净现金流超600亿元，折旧远大于实际维护资本开支，公司章程明确承诺高比例现金分红（派息率约70%）。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: >60B RMB annual operating cash flow; depreciation far exceeds actual maintenance CapEx, backing a committed ~70% payout ratio.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：从中美历史看，无风险利率跌破2.2%后，永续水电资产按DCF折现模型将迎来系统性估值拔升，较近期高点回撤超10%提供买点。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: With China 10Y bond yields at 2.12%, perpetual hydro cash flows command a structural DCF re-rating; 10% pullback offers entry.

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：『煤-电-路-港-航』全产业链一体化闭环运营，高比例长协煤合同锁定利润下限，彻底抹平大宗商品周期剧烈波动。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: Integrated 'Coal-Power-Rail-Port' closed-loop model; long-term contract pricing locks in earnings floor across commodity cycles.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：账面净现金极其充裕，有息负债率极低，过去5年分红复合增长率超14%，实际派息率维持在75%高位。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: Massive net cash balance, minimal debt, >14% 5Y dividend CAGR with a consistent ~75% actual payout ratio.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：PE仅11.6倍，近6%的股息率是国内10年期国债收益率的近3倍，是央行互换便利资金最核心的配置标的。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: 11.6x PE and ~6% dividend yield (nearly 3x China's 10Y bond yield), making it the prime target for PBoC swap facility inflows.

etfs.name_zh: 盈富基金 (恒生指数 ETF)
etfs.action_zh: 历史低位区间 / 定投持有

etfs.name_zh: Global X 恒生高股息率 ETF
etfs.name_en: Global X Hang Seng High Div

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：全球成本最低的海上油气勘探生产商，桶油主要完全成本仅约 28 美元/桶，储量替代率连续多年保持在 130% 以上。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: Lowest-cost offshore E&P globally with all-in cost near $28/bbl and reserve replacement ratio consistently >130%.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：ROE 高达 19%，净现金状态，派息率仅 44% 却能提供超 7.3% 的极高股息率，分红安全垫极厚。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: 19% ROE, net cash balance sheet; a conservative 44% payout ratio still delivers a massive >7.3% dividend yield.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：相比A股（600938.SS）折价超35%，PE仅6.4倍，PEG仅0.68，即便油价跌至55美元依然能维持高分红。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: Trades at >35% discount to its A-share, 6.4x PE and 0.68 PEG; highly profitable even if oil drops to $55/bbl.

screener.moat_zh: 商业模式与护城河：全球最大移动通信运营商（10亿级用户基本盘）+ 移动云算力龙头，5G资本开支已进入下行通道，自由现金流全面释放。
screener.moat_en: Moat & Model: World's largest telecom operator (~1B subscribers) + cloud leader; 5G CapEx cycle is declining, unlocking massive FCF.
screener.quality_zh: 业绩与分红质量：账面广义现金超4000亿人民币，零有息负债压力，官方承诺派息率逐步提升至75%以上。
screener.quality_en: Earnings Quality: Over 400B RMB in cash reserves, zero debt pressure, management committed to raising payout ratio above 75%.
screener.underval_zh: 为何低估（安全边际）：H股较A股折价超30%，PB接近1倍净资产，近7%股息率吸引南向险资持续锁仓。
screener.underval_en: Why Undervalued: >30% discount to A-share, 1.08x P/B, and ~7% yield acting as a magnet for Southbound institutional capital.
